degree.text: Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration

description.text: Teaching Objectives To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses Principles of Management, micro-economics, macro-economics, Management Information System, Statistics, Marketing, Economic Law, Human Resource Management, Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance Management Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration Career Graduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Central China Normal University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Undergraduate school transcript 4.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: graduate student with a good command of English
